up: Extract all molecules that are associated with the document identified by the ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1152129'. For each molecule, retrieve its ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), maximum development phase (molecule_dictionary.max_phase), molecule type (molecule_dictionary.molecule_type), and canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Use the document's doc_id to join through compound_records to molecule_dictionary, and left-join compound_structures to get the SMILES. Do not restrict by any additional filters such as activity data or confidence scores.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1152129';
